---
description: Walk a fresh GitHub consumer journey and expose friction, capability gaps, and false assumptions.
---

Evaluate `ggen-ecosystem` as a fresh consumer rather than as a maintainer who already knows the repository.

Map the journey from repository discovery → clone/bootstrap → exact producer admission → `ggen sync run` → evidence → standing. For every step, name the command or GitHub affordance, required knowledge, expected output, failure modes, and recovery path.

Use real execution where the environment permits it. Never convert an unavailable capability into fabricated success. Classify missing producer/pack capability as `UNSUPPORTED[...]`, transport/runtime failure as the appropriate scoped failure, and documentation/DX friction separately.

End with the highest-leverage reversible DX improvements ranked by how much manual work, ambiguity, or cognitive load they remove. Do not hand-edit GGen-generated projections.
